objective: Verify that the OpenAI/Codex and Claude plugins expose the same explicit reviewed subset of the pending SDK 0.2.43 callable surface, without silent capability growth.

expected_exclusions.amend: Low-level complete-payload mutation is excluded in favour of preview-first amend_current.
expected_exclusions.create_webhook: Webhook infrastructure configuration is outside the participation plugin.
expected_exclusions.delete_webhook: Webhook infrastructure configuration is outside the participation plugin.
expected_exclusions.get: Raw transport would bypass the reviewed semantic action surface.
expected_exclusions.post: Raw transport would bypass the reviewed semantic action surface.
expected_exclusions.webhooks: Webhook infrastructure configuration is outside the participation plugin.

acceptance_checks: Every source checkout is clean and exactly at its frozen commit.
The SDK source declares version 0.2.42 while the plugin range truthfully waits for intended release 0.2.43.
Each plugin requirements file contains exactly ainglish>=0.2.43,<0.3 and its CI, README and skill repeat the range.
The two plugin ALLOWED_ACTIONS sets are byte-for-byte equivalent after sorting.
The exposed set exactly equals the frozen category union with no duplicate category membership.
SDK public callables minus exposed actions equal exactly the six named exclusions.
No exposed action is absent from the SDK and no seventh public callable is silently omitted.
flagship_evidence_map and rename_proposal_slug are present; raw get/post and webhook methods are absent.
claim_boundary: This is a static source and capability-surface audit. It does not establish production deployment, remote MCP parity, authentication success, safe behaviour of every write, or publication of SDK 0.2.43. Those remain separate live gates.
